myths.text: The name means "Power, ability, energy — the active power of a deity personified as his consort" and reflects the figure's role in the tradition.

lore.syncretism: Śakti appears within the Sanskrit tradition and has influenced later retellings, artistic depictions, and scholarly study. The Unicode restoration preserves the name's distinctive orthography for contemporary use.
lore.culturalLegacy: Śakti continues to appear in scholarship, art, and popular reception as a significant figure of the Sanskrit tradition. Restoring the name in Unicode returns the original marks that ASCII removes.
lore.extendedMeditation: Śakti embodies power, energy, divine feminine in the Sanskrit imagination. The name's restoration is not merely cosmetic: it recovers the stress, length, and script that make the figure recognizable in the source tradition.
lore.archaeology: Śakti is attested in the textual and iconographic record of the Sanskrit tradition.
